approved_claims: Version 0.3.0 is an independent, metadata-only, AI-generated proof of concept for discovering public HM Land Registry material; it is not an HM Land Registry service or endorsement.
The exact candidate contains 2,203 public metadata records across 17 governed source families and contains no property-level records.

The catalogue is a frozen snapshot with a research cut-off of 29 July 2026; completeness is limited to the named, dated and reconciled acquisition lanes and is not claimed for the HM Land Registry public estate as a whole.

Every one of the 2,203 catalogue records carries an explicit access state, rights state, rights-assessment reference, caveat and evidence reference; public availability is not treated as open-reuse permission.
The public projection contains metadata and source links only; candidate generation did not authenticate to, execute, search or monitor a restricted HM Land Registry service.

The candidate publishes canonical YAML-LD and equivalent JSON-LD serialisations of one bounded semantic graph, with 22,267 direct triples, 22,267 reified relationship assertions and 22,267 runtime rows reconciled to the same identities.
All 22,267 semantic assertions and all 22,267 relationship-runtime rows pass the pinned local schema and reconciliation checks with zero validation failure.
The candidate publishes 22 authorised predicate capabilities: 13 active-emitted capabilities carrying 22,267 assertions and nine authorised-zero-evidence capabilities carrying zero assertions.
The candidate records a selective metadata-level public-service mapping for seven of 11 reviewed candidates, with four explicit exclusions and 19 evidence references.
Official CPSV-AP SHACL and semantic inference were not run, and neither CPSV-AP conformance nor inferred knowledge is claimed.
The exact candidate passed six local product journeys and 26 local search journeys against the pinned OKF Explorer v0.6.2 consumer.

On the bounded synthetic 24-question evaluation, the candidate recorded mean reciprocal rank 0.916667, expected-target recall at 10 of 1.0, all-expected-target success at 10 of 1.0 and zero hard failures.

The exact candidate passed the documented AI-assisted keyboard, focus, zoom, reflow, forced-colours and reduced-motion journeys within the explicitly bounded proof-of-concept test scope; this is not a human accessibility audit or WCAG conformance claim.
The exact candidate passes all pinned Explorer rich-relationship limits, including full default hydration of 22,267 rows and 33,231,836 retained-text units against the 33,554,432-unit ceiling.

Two clean offline builds using the locked CPython 3.12.11 environment produced byte-identical governed bundle output at release root 6a29e38e7bb805aafb7f36ba8d1fa4ce976875f45997049cd4808d6ede7f75e1; the two 38,906,084-byte candidate archives are byte-identical at SHA-256 3ed5fe3b01fcacd6422493016f9089d89d71eab655e58e154201035b7d97f75e.

The candidate does not provide legal advice, proof of ownership or priority, an exact-boundary conclusion, a complete or current public-estate inventory, bilingual parity or participant-validated user research.
No independent human domain, legal, licence, privacy, security or accessibility audit has been completed for this AI-generated proof of concept.
